questions.stem: A cube whose edge is 14 cm long has on each of its faces a circle of 7 cm radius painted yellow. What is the total area of unpainted surface ? (Take \(\pi = \frac{22}{7}\))

From a circular metal plate of radius 7 cm and thickness 0.16 mm, a sector is cut off containing an angle \(150^\circ\). The remaining piece is moulded into a spherical bead of radius r. What is the value of r in cm ?

The chord AB of a circle with centre at O is \(2\sqrt{3}\) times the height of the minor segment. If P is the area of the sector OAB and Q is the area of the minor segment of the circle, then what is the approximate value of \(\frac{P}{Q}\) ?

(Take \(\sqrt{3} = 1.7\) and \(\pi = 3.14\))

What is the area of the region between two concentric circles, if the length of a chord of the outer circle touching the inner circle at a particular point of its circumference is 14 cm ? (Take \(\pi = \frac{22}{7}\))

questions.stem: In a right-angled triangle ABC, AB = 15 cm, BC = 20 cm and AC = 25 cm. Further, BP is the perpendicular on AC. What is the difference in the area of triangles PAB and PCB ?

Let the positive numbers \(a_1, a_2, a_3, \ldots, a_{3n}\) be in GP. If P is the GM of \(a_1, a_2, a_3, \ldots, a_n\) and Q is the GM of \(a_{n+1}, a_{n+2}, a_{n+3}, \ldots, a_{3n}\), then what is the GM of 3n numbers ?
The cost price of y articles is equal to selling price of z articles. If y : z = 5 : 4, what is the profit percentage ?
A sum of money invested at simple interest triples itself in 8 years and becomes n times in 20 years. What is the value of n ?
If the work done by x men in \((x + 1)\) days is equal to the work done by \((x + 5)\) men in \((x - 2)\) days, then what is the value of x ?
If \((a + b) : (b + c) : (c + a) = 5 : 7 : 6\), then what is the value of \((a - b + c) : (a + b - c)\) ?

Let x be the compound interest at the end of 3 years on a sum of Rs. 1000 at the rate of 10% compounded annually and y be the simple interest at the end of 3 years on a sum of Rs. 1000 at the annual rate of 11%. What is the difference between x and y ?

questions.stem: In a quadrilateral ABCD, AB = 6 cm, BC = 18 cm, CD = 6 cm and DA = 10 cm. If diagonal BD = x, then which one of the following is correct ?
In a quarter circle of radius R, a circle of radius r is inscribed. What is the ratio of R to r ?
In a quadrilateral ABCD, AB = BC and CD = DA; AC and BD are diagonals such that AC = 6 cm and BD = 12 cm. What is the area of the quadrilateral ?
If \(\tan(3A) = \cot(A - 22^\circ)\), where 3A is an acute angle, then what is the value of A ?
If \(\frac{\sin\theta - \cos\theta + 1}{\sin\theta + \cos\theta - 1} = p\sec\theta + q\tan\theta\), where \(0 < \theta < \frac{\pi}{2}\), then what is \(p + q\) equal to ?

The angles of elevation of the top of a tower from two points A and B at a distance of x m and \((x + 5)\) m from the base of the tower of height 6 m and in the same straight line with it are complementary. What is the value of x ?

Consider the following statements :

1. In a triangle ABC, if \(\sin A + \sin B + \sin C = \frac{3\sqrt{3}}{2}\), then the triangle can be equilateral.

2. In a triangle ABC, if \(\cos A + \cos B + \cos C = \frac{3}{2}\), then the triangle can be equilateral.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?

2. PQ varies as R.

3. \(P^2 - Q^2\) varies as R.
